remarks: Don't miss this investment opportunity! Smart, Stylish, and Superbly Located - 1-Bedroom Condo in Highview East. This bright and efficient garden-level condo offers everything you need in one smart, stylish package. With 654 square feet of thoughtfully designed one-level living, this 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit features a seamless open layout that combines the kitchen, dining area, and living room into one inviting space. The updated kitchen includes marble countertops and stainless steel appliances, while newer flooring and oversized closets add both freshness and function. You'll love the ease of in-unit laundry, central air, and forced hot air heat for year-round comfort. Step outside to your private patio, just steps from the in-ground pool-ideal for relaxing or entertaining on warm days. Located in the sought-after Highview East complex, this unit also offers low common charges, assigned parking, and ample visitor parking. Minutes to I-95, Metro-North, the SONO Collection, beaches, restaurants, and Oak Hills Golf Course. Plus, it's walking distance to Norwalk Hospital-a perfect fit for medical professionals. New water heater, new floors and freshly painted, brand new water heater with a nine year warranty, maintained HVAC system with service contract, the fact that the parking lots are scheduled to be redone in July with no extra charge to the community. Current tenant paying $1850 with lease to March 2026. Easy to own, easy to rent. Great investment opportunity.
